requirements.1: Explain bias and variance of the implemented American price estimator.
requirements.2: GBM Milstein versus Euler and BAW, retaining the European control.
requirements.3: Printed stochastic-volatility Milstein versus Euler, BAW proxy and same-model refinement.
requirements.4: Errors across 10,000–100,000 evaluation paths and explain convergence.

assumptions.inputs: GBM uses the Exercise 2 inputs; the stochastic-volatility model and contract use the Exercise 1 baseline. Each study simulates new paths.
assumptions.exercise_grid: Daily for both models; old Exercise 1 SV results used 50/year and are not matched comparators.
assumptions.path_counts: Training fixed; evaluation uses nested prefixes of a maximum sample. Prefix estimates are dependent.
assumptions.error_sign: Reference minus estimate. SV BAW gap is a model comparison, not pure numerical error.
assumptions.uncertainty: Sample variance/N conditions on fitted rules and beta. Excludes training variability and numerical bias.
assumptions.control: Exact GBM European terminal payoff shares American Brownian increments. Training beta fixed during evaluation. No SV Black–Scholes control.
assumptions.sampler: Wiktorsson two-driver Fourier series with conditional Gaussian tail. n=ceil(sqrt(5/(6*pi²*h))); chosen integral MSE budget h³, h in years; separate area draws.
assumptions.boundary: Finite interior coefficient products extended to zero, then variance proposal projected to zero. No strong-order theorem asserted at the boundary.
assumptions.reference: Under a well-defined nonnegative continuous spot solution with zero drift, put waiting is optimal. Refined projected-Euler maturity payments give a numerical, not exact, reference.
assumptions.gamma: GBM gamma repeats the Exercise 2 profile at one evaluation path count. The stochastic-volatility study compares option prices.

settings.coupling: Sum increments from the finest grid.
settings.order_fit: OLS slope of log terminal RMSE against log timestep over all six grids.

gbm_convergence.meaning: Terminal spot RMSE against exact GBM on coupled Brownian paths; not American pricing error.

sv_reference.meaning: Projected Euler terminal-payoff numerical reference; sampling uncertainty and residual refinement/projection error remain.

settings.valuation: Fresh LSMC fit for every scheme/setting.
settings.coupling: Brownian endpoints coupled across schemes, timesteps and area accuracy. Area tails are not a nested strong coupling.

sv_stability.meaning: A representative complete-fit stability check; doubled sampler accuracy is not a proof of strong pathwise order.

settings.interpretation: Limited GBM carryover of Exercise 2; policies refit at each bump; conditional variance only, no claim about full-training gamma variance.
